established.method: Fault injection, not revert. A --path revert of app/lib/deliverAndStamp.ts deletes the module the test imports, so the without-fix world did-not-build (prove-red BLOCKED, verdict UNPROVABLE). Instead the ordering guard itself was neutered in place — 'if (!delivery.ok) { return not-delivered }' short-circuited to 'if (false && !delivery.ok)' so stamping runs unconditionally — then refresh-tests --file app/lib/deliverAndStamp.test.ts was run, the guard restored, and the suite re-run.
established.evidence: With the guard neutered: {failed:3, passed:78, total:81}, success:false — 'does not stamp when the provider rejects the send', 'reports the provider reason on a failed send', and 'works without an onProblem hook' all went red. With the guard restored: {failed:0, passed:81}, success:true. The fixture and expectations were not touched between the two runs.
